literal: The dark signs of heaven show their brightness to observe the changes of the seasons—that is celestial pattern.
idiomatic: Heaven's dark signs shine forth to read the seasons' turn—that is celestial pattern.

literal: Sages and the accomplished set forth words and transform the empire—that is human pattern.
idiomatic: Sages and the accomplished set words in the world and transform it—that is human pattern.

literal: To reach the sentiments of hidden and manifest and clarify the boundary between Heaven and man—is this not found in wen?
idiomatic: To sound the feelings of hidden and manifest and clarify where Heaven and man meet—is that not the work of wen?

literal: Listening far back to the three antiquities, spanning a hundred generations, establishing rites and composing music, making substance soar and fame fly abroad—if words lacked pattern, how could their influence travel far?
idiomatic: Listening back through the three antiquities and spanning a hundred generations, they set rites and made music, lifting substance and sending fame abroad—yet if words lacked pattern, how could their reach endure?

literal: The Master said, "When King Wen was already gone, was not the culture here?
idiomatic: The Master said, "When King Wen was already gone, was not the culture here?

literal: " The Great Sage followed in his footsteps, nearly a thousand years distant; in between, outstanding worthies beyond counting—all should have laid down the brush and stilled the writing desk, not speaking of wen—yet talent was hard to find; was it not so?
idiomatic: " The Great Sage followed in his wake, nearly a thousand years on; between them outstanding men beyond count—all might have laid down brush and stilled the desk and left wen unspoken—yet talent was scarce; was it not so?

literal: As for You and Xia, who excelled in literary phrasing, Yan Hui who nearly reached sagehood, Qu Yuan and Song Yu who followed in the dust, and Sima Xiangru and Yang Xiong who could not lay down the bamboo slip—
idiomatic: You and Xia excelled in literary phrasing; Yan Hui nearly reached sagehood; Qu Yuan and Song Yu followed in the dust; Sima Xiangru and Yang Xiong could not lay down the slip—

literal: then literary talents and fine minds surged like waves and clustered like clouds, shaking the phoenix's pinions and letting the carved dragon's brilliance run free; men said they had gained the dark pearl at Red Water and driven lightning across Kunlun, opening fourfold radiance upon spring flowers and amassing ten thousand treasures in autumn fruit.
idiomatic: then men of letters and fine minds surged like waves and clustered like clouds, shaking phoenix pinions and letting carved-dragon brilliance run free; they were said to have taken the dark pearl at Red Water and driven lightning across Kunqiu, opening fourfold radiance on spring flowers and heaping ten thousand treasures in autumn fruit.

literal: Yet where wen arises, feeling stirs from within.
idiomatic: Yet wen arises when feeling stirs within.

literal: Man has the six feelings and receives the excellence of the five constants;
idiomatic: Man has six feelings and receives the excellence of the five constants;

literal: feeling responds to the six qi and follows the sequence of the four seasons.
idiomatic: feeling answers the six qi and follows the four seasons' order.

literal: Those who possess Heaven's endowment suspended and released, Heaven's unbounded many gifts, weaving brocade patterns from innate knowing and seeking jade tablets from foreknowing sages—as if carved clouds formed five colors of themselves, as if the ritual phoenix secretly matched the eight tones—such men are moved by heroic spirit to stand apart; it is not what laboring mind can achieve.
idiomatic: Those Heaven-endowed and Heaven-talented, weaving brocade from innate knowing and seeking jade from foreknowing sages—as if carved clouds took five colors of themselves, as if the ritual phoenix matched the eight tones in secret—are lifted by heroic spirit; no laboring mind can force that.

literal: Even if feeling and thought sink to the bottom and the key-bolt will not turn, so long as one bows the breast without slackening and drills upward with utmost keenness, racing among masters and turning with worthy friends, strengthening study to broaden sight and hearing and concentrating the mind to bar vain seeking—painting and adorning with cinnabar and green, carving and polishing into useful vessels—then learning and thereby knowing still suffices to make one worthy.
idiomatic: Even when feeling and thought stall and the key will not turn, if one bows the breast without slackening, drills upward with keenness, races among masters and turns with worthy friends, strengthens study to widen sight and hearing and bars the mind from vain seeking—painting with cinnabar and green, carving into useful vessels—then to learn and know still makes one worthy enough.

literal: To take stone for beast and shoot it so the hole opens clear—that is the utmost of skill.
idiomatic: To take stone for beast and shoot until the hole opens clean—that is skill at its utmost.

literal: Year upon year to dissect the ox until the blade hums through the gaps—that is long practice.
idiomatic: Year upon year to dissect the ox until the blade hums through the gaps—that is long practice.

literal: Unless one's form were Chaos that nothing can carve and one's heart held an unshifting feeling for the extreme, how could there be success through utmost skill and long habit?
idiomatic: Unless one's form were Chaos that nothing can carve and one's heart held feeling that would not shift, how could utmost skill and long habit ever succeed?

literal: Well said is Emperor Wen of Wei's treatise: "Most men do not strengthen their force; in poverty and low estate they shrink before hunger and cold, in wealth and honor they drift into ease and pleasure, then scheme for the business at hand and abandon merit for a thousand years. The sun and moon flee above while the body declines below; suddenly one transforms with the ten thousand things—this is the great pain of men of resolve."
idiomatic: Well said is Emperor Wen of Wei's treatise: "Most men do not strengthen their force; poor and lowly, they shrink before hunger and cold; rich and honored, they drift into ease and pleasure; they scheme for what lies before them and abandon work for a thousand years. Sun and moon flee overhead while the body fails below; suddenly one transforms with the ten thousand things—that is the great pain of men of resolve."

literal: Shen Yue said, "From Han to Wei, more than four hundred years—men of letters and fine minds; literary forms changed thrice."
idiomatic: Shen Yue said, "From Han to Wei, more than four hundred years—men of letters and fine minds; literary forms changed thrice."

literal: Yet from then until afterward, tracks and ruts were especially many.
idiomatic: Yet from then on, tracks and ruts multiplied all the more.

literal: East of the Yangzi in late Liang, frivolity and peril were still more honored, beginning in the crown prince's quarters and reaching the floating customs, mixing turbid clamor to make sound—thus though mournful, it was not refined.
idiomatic: East of the Yangzi in late Liang, frivolity and peril were honored still more, beginning in the crown prince's quarters and spreading through floating custom, mixing turbid clamor into music—so that though mournful, it was not refined.

literal: Down to Wuping, government strayed and the age was worm-eaten; only the beauty of literary thought and the elegant way still survived—treading softness and compliance to make wen, enduring great calamity yet remaining upright.
idiomatic: Down to Wuping, government strayed and the age rotted; only literary thought's beauty and the elegant way survived—treading softness and compliance to make wen, enduring great calamity yet keeping upright.

literal: Tracing the two dynasties' declining age, both indulged in licentious sound; yet Qi changed the wind and lodged it in string and pipe, while Liang changed the ya and placed it in chapters and stanzas.
idiomatic: Both dynasties in their declining age indulged licentious sound; yet Qi changed the wind and put it in string and pipe, while Liang changed the ya and put it in chapters and stanzas.

literal: All were brought about by changing custom and together were music of a perishing state;
idiomatic: All came from changing custom and together made music of a perishing state;

literal: yet responding to change was not different while being moved by things sometimes differed—why?
idiomatic: yet responding to change was the same while being moved by things sometimes differed—why?

literal: It followed the ruler's desires and feelings above.
idiomatic: It followed the desires and feelings of the ruler above.

literal: When Qi from its hegemonic design onward broadly extended eminent worthies, opened four gates to receive them, and raised eight cords to cover them, below Ye capital mist and fog gathered—Hejian Xing Zicai, Julu Wei Boqi, Fanyang Lu Yuanming, Julu Wei Jijing, Qinghe Cui Changru, Hejian Xing Ziming, Fanyang Zu Xiaozheng, Le'an Sun Yanju, Zhongshan Du Fuxuan, and Beiping Yang Zilie were all of that current.
idiomatic: When Qi from its hegemonic design onward extended eminent worthies, opened four gates to receive them, and raised eight cords to gather them, below Ye mist and fog clustered—Hejian Xing Zicai, Julu Wei Boqi, Fanyang Lu Yuanming, Julu Wei Jijing, Qinghe Cui Changru, Hejian Xing Ziming, Fanyang Zu Xiaozheng, Le'an Sun Yanju, Zhongshan Du Fuxuan, and Beiping Yang Zilie were all of that stream.

literal: There was also Fanyang Zu Hongxun, who likewise joined the ranks of literary gentlemen.
idiomatic: Fanyang Zu Hongxun also joined the ranks of literary gentlemen.

literal: In the Tianbao era, Li Yin, Lu Qiong, Cui Zhan, and Lu Yuangui were all in the Secretariat, participating in drafting edicts and commands.
idiomatic: In the Tianbao era, Li Yin, Lu Qiong, Cui Zhan, and Lu Yuangui were all in the Secretariat, sharing in the drafting of edicts and commands.

literal: Li Guang, Fan Xun, Li Delin, Lu Xunzu, and Lu Sidao first became famous for their writings.
idiomatic: Li Guang, Fan Xun, Li Delin, Lu Xunzu, and Lu Sidao first won fame through their writings.

literal: In the Huangjian reign, Regular Attendant Wang Xi alone monopolized the beauty of it.
idiomatic: In the Huangjian reign, Regular Attendant Wang Xi alone held the beauty of it.

literal: In the Heqing and Tiantong eras, Du Taiqing, Liu Ti, and Wei Qian also participated in knowing edicts and commands.
idiomatic: In the Heqing and Tiantong eras, Du Taiqing, Liu Ti, and Wei Qian also shared in edicts and commands.

literal: From Yin downward, within the Secretariat they only compiled and drafted appointments and dismissal edicts; documents touching military and state affairs were mostly written by Wei Shou.
idiomatic: From Yin downward, within the Secretariat they only compiled appointments and dismissal edicts; documents touching military and state affairs were mostly Wei Shou's work.

literal: In Wuping, Li Ruo, Xun Shixun, Li Delin, and Xue Daheng were secretariat vice ministers; military and state documents and great edicts and commands were all Delin's brush—Daheng and the others did not participate.
idiomatic: In Wuping, Li Ruo, Xun Shixun, Li Delin, and Xue Daheng were secretariat vice ministers; military and state papers and great edicts were all Delin's brush—Daheng and the rest did not take part.

literal: Though the Later Sovereign was drowned among petty men, he was quite fond of reciting and chanting; in childhood he had read poetry and fu and said to people, "Will there in the end be someone who understands how to make this principle?
idiomatic: Though the Later Sovereign was drowned among petty men, he was quite fond of recitation; as a child he had read poetry and fu and said to people, "Will there in the end be someone who understands how to make this art?

literal: " When he grew up he also gave it some attention.
idiomatic: " When he grew up he gave it some attention as well.

literal: At first, because of painted screens, he ordered Unhampered Attendant Xiao Fang of Lanling and Wang Xiaoshi of Jinling to record ancient worthies, martyrs, and recent frivolous poems to fill the pictures; the emperor valued this all the more.
idiomatic: At first, for painted screens, he ordered Unhampered Attendant Xiao Fang of Lanling and Wang Xiaoshi of Jinling to record ancient worthies, martyrs, and recent frivolous poems to fill the pictures; the emperor valued this still more.

literal: Later he again summoned Qi province recorder-assistant Xiao Yi and Zhao province merit-clerk Yan Zhitui to enter and compile together, still following the hegemonic court—calling them lodge guests.
idiomatic: Later he again summoned Qi recorder-assistant Xiao Yi and Zhao merit-clerk Yan Zhitui to compile together, still under the hegemonic court—calling them lodge guests.

literal: Fang and Zhitui wished to broaden the affair further; Zu Ting was also assisting in government and cherished Zhitui; through Deng Changyong he gradually persuaded the Later Sovereign to set his mind on this literature.
idiomatic: Fang and Zhitui wished to broaden the work further; Zu Ting was also assisting in government and cherished Zhitui; through Deng Changyong he gradually persuaded the Later Sovereign to set his mind on this literature.

literal: In the third year Zu Ting memorialized to establish the Forest of Literature Hall; literary gentlemen were again summoned and called awaiting-edict gentlemen of the Forest of Literature.
idiomatic: In the third year Zu Ting memorialized to establish the Forest of Literature Hall; literary gentlemen were summoned again and called awaiting-edict gentlemen of the Forest of Literature.

literal: Ting again memorialized to compile the Imperial Overview; an edict ordered Ting and specially advanced Wei Shou, Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince Xu Zhicai, Secretariat Director Cui Jie, scattered-cavalry regular attendant Zhang Diao, and Secretariat Supervisor Yang Xiuzhi to supervise the compilation.
idiomatic: Ting again memorialized to compile the Imperial Overview; an edict ordered Ting, specially advanced Wei Shou, Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince Xu Zhicai, Secretariat Director Cui Jie, scattered-cavalry regular attendant Zhang Diao, and Secretariat Supervisor Yang Xiuzhi to supervise it.

literal: Ting and the others memorialized to recall unhampered scattered-cavalry vice minister Wei Daoxun, Lu Yi, crown prince household retainer Wang Shao, commandery-wei aide Li Xiaoji, palace investigation censor Wei Tan, palace standard grandee Liu Zhongwei, Yuan Shuang, National University doctorate Zhu Cai, chariot-of-the-court commandant Sui Daoxian, merit-examination bureau director Cui Zishu, left outer-troops bureau gentleman Xue Daohang, joint-province guest-bureau director Lu Sidao, Minister of Works eastern-pavilion sacrifice wine Cui De, Grand Academy doctorate Zhuge Han, court gentleman attendant Zheng Gongchao, palace investigation censor Zheng Zixin, and others into the hall to compile books, and also ordered Fang, Yi, and Zhitui to enter the compilation rules together.
idiomatic: Ting and the others memorialized to recall unhampered scattered-cavalry vice minister Wei Daoxun, Lu Yi, crown prince household retainer Wang Shao, commandery-wei aide Li Xiaoji, palace investigation censor Wei Tan, palace standard grandee Liu Zhongwei, Yuan Shuang, National University doctorate Zhu Cai, chariot-of-the-court commandant Sui Daoxian, merit-examination director Cui Zishu, left outer-troops gentleman Xue Daohang, joint-province guest-bureau director Lu Sidao, Minister of Works eastern-pavilion sacrifice wine Cui De, Grand Academy doctorate Zhuge Han, court gentleman attendant Zheng Gongchao, palace investigation censor Zheng Zixin, and others into the hall to compile, and also ordered Fang, Yi, and Zhitui to enter the compilation rules together.

literal: They again ordered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Feng Xiaoyan, former music-commandery grand administrator Zheng Yuanli, commandery-wei vice director Du Taiqing, unhampered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Wang Xun, former southern Yanzhou chief clerk Yang Su, unhampered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Ma Yuanxi, joint-province three-offices bureau director Liu Min, opening-office acting retainer Li Shishang, and Wen Junyou into the hall, also to compile books.
idiomatic: They again ordered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Feng Xiaoyan, former music-commandery administrator Zheng Yuanli, commandery-wei vice director Du Taiqing, unhampered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Wang Xun, former southern Yanzhou chief clerk Yang Su, unhampered scattered-cavalry regular attendant Ma Yuanxi, joint-province three-offices director Liu Min, opening-office acting retainer Li Shishang, and Wen Junyou into the hall, also to compile.

literal: They again commanded specially advanced Cui Jishu, former Renzhou inspector Liu Ti, scattered-cavalry regular attendant Li Xiaozhen, and secretariat vice minister Li Delin to continue entering as awaiting-edict.
idiomatic: They again commanded specially advanced Cui Jishu, former Renzhou inspector Liu Ti, scattered-cavalry regular attendant Li Xiaozhen, and secretariat vice minister Li Delin to continue entering as awaiting-edict.

literal: Soon an edict also ordered each man to recommend those he knew; there were also former Jizhou chief clerk Li Xu, former Guangwu grand administrator Wei Qian, former western Yanzhou marshal Xiao Gai, former Youzhou chief clerk Lu Renhui, Zhengzhou marshal Jiang Gan, former unhampered scattered-cavalry vice minister Xin Deyuan, Lu Kaiming, unhampered gentleman Feng Xiaojie, grand marshal retainer Zhang Dechong, joint-province right-populace bureau gentleman Gao Xinggong, Secretariat household-census retainer Gu Daozi, former Minister of Works merit-clerk retainer Liu Yi, Huojia magistrate Cui Deru, giving-the-affairs attendant Li Yuankai, Jinzhou acting administrator Yang Shixiao, grand marshal central-troops retainer Liu Ruxing, Minister of Works sacrifice wine Yang Bijiang, Minister of Works scholar-census retainer Lu Gongshun, Secretariat central-troops retainer Zhou Zishen, opening-office retainer Wang Youbo, Cui Junqia, and Wei Shijian—all entered the hall as awaiting-edict; an edict also ordered right vice director of the masters of writing Duan Xiaoyan to enter as well.
idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered each man to recommend those he knew; there were also former Jizhou chief clerk Li Xu, former Guangwu administrator Wei Qian, former western Yanzhou marshal Xiao Gai, former Youzhou chief clerk Lu Renhui, Zhengzhou marshal Jiang Gan, former unhampered scattered-cavalry vice minister Xin Deyuan, Lu Kaiming, unhampered gentleman Feng Xiaojie, grand marshal retainer Zhang Dechong, joint-province right-populace gentleman Gao Xinggong, Secretariat household-census retainer Gu Daozi, former Minister of Works merit-clerk retainer Liu Yi, Huojia magistrate Cui Deru, giving-the-affairs attendant Li Yuankai, Jinzhou acting administrator Yang Shixiao, grand marshal central-troops retainer Liu Ruxing, Minister of Works sacrifice wine Yang Bijiang, Minister of Works scholar-census retainer Lu Gongshun, Secretariat central-troops retainer Zhou Zishen, opening-office retainer Wang Youbo, Cui Junqia, and Wei Shijian—all entered the hall as awaiting-edict; an edict also ordered right vice director of the masters of writing Duan Xiaoyan to enter.

literal: After the Imperial Overview was completed, among those recorded and compiled some did not await edict in time and were handed to the relevant office for disposition.
idiomatic: After the Imperial Overview was completed, some of those recorded did not await edict in time and were handed to the relevant office for disposition.

literal: Of all these men, some thirteen or fourteen in ten also had shallow literary learning, attached themselves to kin and acquaintances, and recklessly recommended one another.
idiomatic: Of all these men, perhaps thirteen or fourteen in ten also had shallow literary learning, clung to kin and acquaintances, and recklessly pushed one another forward.

literal: Even so, those who wielded the brush at the time were sought out nearly to exhaustion.
idiomatic: Even so, those who wielded the brush at the time were sought out almost to the last.

literal: Beyond them, such as Guangping Song Xiaowang and Xindu Liu Shanjing and a few others—in talent and nature, thirteen or fourteen in ten of the hall's worthies did not reach them.
idiomatic: Beyond them, such as Guangping Song Xiaowang and Xindu Liu Shanjing and a few others—in talent and nature, thirteen or fourteen in ten of the hall's worthies did not match them.

literal: Awaiting edict at the Forest of Literature was also a grand affair of the age; therefore their names are preserved in the record.
idiomatic: Awaiting edict at the Forest of Literature was itself a grand affair of the age; therefore their names are preserved here.

literal: From Xing Zicai onward, some ended their lives in the Wei court and already entered the earlier histories;
idiomatic: From Xing Zicai onward, some ended their lives in the Wei court and already entered the earlier histories;

literal: some had name and rank already weighty and have their own separate biographies;
idiomatic: some had name and rank already weighty and have their own biographies;

literal: some are attached to their family lines;
idiomatic: some are attached to their family lines;

literal: some have names preserved in later books—here they are briefly omitted from recording.
idiomatic: some have names preserved in later books—here they are briefly omitted.

literal: Now in sequence I set forth Zu Hongxun and those listed in Men of Letters.
idiomatic: Now I set forth in sequence Zu Hongxun and those listed in Men of Letters.

literal: Beyond these, whatever can be recorded is kept at the chapter's end.
idiomatic: Beyond these, whatever can be recorded is kept at the chapter's end.

literal: Zu Hongxun was a man of Fanyang in Zhuo commandery.
idiomatic: Zu Hongxun came from Fanyang in Zhuo commandery.

literal: His father Shen served Wei as grand administrator of Yanmen and Xianyang; in governance he had a reputation for ability.
idiomatic: His father Shen served Wei as grand administrator of Yanmen and Xianyang; in governance he had a reputation for ability.

literal: He died as golden-gleaming grand master for splendid virtue, posthumously enfeoffed as Secretariat Supervisor and inspector of You province, with the posthumous title Marquis Hui.
idiomatic: He died as golden-gleaming grand master for splendid virtue, posthumously enfeoffed as Secretariat Supervisor and inspector of You province, with the posthumous title Marquis Hui.

literal: At twenty sui Hongxun and Lu Wenfu of the same commandery together served as provincial recorder.
idiomatic: At twenty sui Hongxun and Lu Wenfu of the same commandery together served as provincial recorder.

literal: The vice director of the masters of writing, the Prince of Huaiyang, once memorialized recommending Hongxun for literary learning and that he should be tried in an office; an edict appointed him court gentleman attendant.
idiomatic: Vice director of the masters of writing the Prince of Huaiyang once memorialized that Hongxun had literary learning and should be tried in office; an edict appointed him court gentleman attendant.

literal: Someone said to him, "The Prince of Huaiyang recommended you, and you immediately gained assignment—yet you never thanked him; I fear that is not fitting.
idiomatic: Someone said to him, "The Prince of Huaiyang recommended you, and you immediately gained assignment—yet you never thanked him; I fear that is not fitting.

literal: " Hongxun said, "To recommend talent for the state is the Prince of Huaiyang's duty—what business has Zu Hongxun in following to thank him?
idiomatic: " Hongxun said, "To recommend talent for the state is the Prince of Huaiyang's duty—what business has Zu Hongxun in following to thank him?

literal: " When Yu heard it he was pleased and said, "I have got my man."
idiomatic: " When Yu heard it he was pleased and said, "I have got my man."

literal: When Ge Rong pressed southward he went out as separate general defending the river and held Hua Terrace.
idiomatic: When Ge Rong pressed southward he went out as separate general defending the river and held Hua Terrace.

literal: At the beginning of Yong'an, Yuan Luo was eastern-route grand ambassador and appointed Feng Longzhi, Xing Shao, Li Hun, Li Xiang, and Hongxun all as deputy envoys.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an, Yuan Luo was eastern-route grand ambassador and appointed Feng Longzhi, Xing Shao, Li Hun, Li Xiang, and Hongxun all as deputy envoys.

literal: He was appointed grand administrator of eastern Jibei; because his father was old and ill he requested leave and in the end did not take office.
idiomatic: He was appointed grand administrator of eastern Jibei; because his father was old and ill he requested leave and in the end did not take office.

literal: Later the Prince of Chengyang, Hui, memorialized Hongxun as legal-affairs retainer in the Secretariat; he went to Luoyang, and Hui said to him, "I heard that when the Prince of Huaiyang recommended you, you never came to the door—why have you come now?
idiomatic: Later the Prince of Chengyang, Hui, memorialized Hongxun as Secretariat legal-affairs retainer; he went to Luoyang, and Hui said to him, "I heard that when the Prince of Huaiyang recommended you, you never came to the door—why have you come now?

literal: " Hongxun said, "I come now to take up duty, not to thank for favor."
idiomatic: " Hongxun said, "I come now to take up duty, not to thank for favor."

literal: He was transferred to director of the Court of Justice.
idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Court of Justice.

literal: Later he left office and returned to his native district; he wrote to Yang Xiuzhi:
idiomatic: Later he left office and returned to his native district; he wrote to Yang Xiuzhi:

literal: Elder Brother Yang: lately, because my family is poor and my parents old, I have from time to time returned to my home commandery.
idiomatic: Elder Brother Yang: lately, because my family is poor and my parents old, I have from time to time returned to my home commandery.

literal: On the western border of this county there is Eagle Mountain.
idiomatic: On the western border of this county there is Eagle Mountain.

literal: The place is secluded and far, its waters and stones clear and lovely; high cliffs surround it on four sides, and good fields number several qing.
idiomatic: The place is secluded and far; waters and stones are clear and lovely; high cliffs ring it on four sides, and good fields number several qing.

literal: My family once had a rustic lodge there, but it fell to ruin in the turmoil; now I am building it anew.
idiomatic: My family once had a rustic lodge there, but turmoil left it in ruins; now I am building it anew.

literal: Taking stone for foundation and leaning on the woods to raise beams.
idiomatic: Taking stone for foundation and leaning on the woods to raise beams.

literal: Creepers reflect on the eaves; springs wind around the steps.
idiomatic: Creepers reflect on the eaves; springs wind around the steps.

literal: Moon, pine, wind, and grass—along the courtyard, brocade pavilions;
idiomatic: Moon, pine, wind, and grass—along the courtyard, brocade pavilions;

literal: sun's glory, clouds, and fruit—beside the pool, stars scattered.
idiomatic: sun's glory, clouds, and fruit—beside the pool, stars scattered.

literal: Beneath the eaves drifting smoke rises and falls together with the sky's breath;
idiomatic: Beneath the eaves drifting smoke rises and falls with the sky's breath;

literal: in the garden peach and plum mix with cedar and cypress in verdant profusion.
idiomatic: in the garden peach and plum mix with cedar and cypress in verdant profusion.

literal: From time to time I lift my robe and ford the stream, lean on my staff and climb the peak; my heart drifts lonely upward and my body seems about to float away—so remote that I no longer know myself to be between Heaven and earth.
idiomatic: From time to time I lift my robe and ford the stream, lean on my staff and climb the peak; my heart drifts lonely upward and my body seems about to float away—so remote that I no longer know myself to stand between Heaven and earth.

literal: When this had lasted long, I would return to where I dwelt, sit alone on a perilous rock, stroke the zither facing the water, chant alone on the mountain slope, raise my cup and gaze at the moon, listen to the wind's sound to stir thought and hear the crane's cry to move the breast.
idiomatic: When this had lasted long, I would return to where I dwelt, sit alone on a perilous rock, stroke the zither facing the water, chant alone on the mountain slope, raise my cup and gaze at the moon, listen to the wind to stir thought and hear the crane's cry to move the breast.

literal: I look up to Master Zhuang's free wandering and admire Master Shang's clear expanse.
idiomatic: I look up to Master Zhuang's free wandering and admire Master Shang's clear expanse.

literal: I wear on my head the budding sedge, on my body coarse cloth; going out I gather millet and grain, returning I serve my kindly parent; easy pace counts as carriage, having nothing to do is honor—this is already enough; must one brush the dust?
idiomatic: I wear budding sedge on my head and coarse cloth on my body; going out I gather millet and grain, returning I serve my kindly parent; easy pace counts as carriage, having nothing to do is honor—this is already enough; must one brush the dust?

literal: Yet my life is already bound by the bridle of fame and reputation and goes to the good artisan's carving.
idiomatic: Yet my life is already bound by the bridle of fame and reputation and goes to the good artisan's carving.

literal: I shake my girdle-pendants above the Purple Terrace and beat my sleeves below the cinnabar steps.
idiomatic: I shake my girdle-pendants above the Purple Terrace and beat my sleeves below the cinnabar steps.

literal: I gather leaking bamboo slips from the golden coffer and seek surviving texts from the jade mountain.
idiomatic: I gather leaking bamboo slips from the golden coffer and seek surviving texts from the jade mountain.

literal: I wear out spirit on the hill graves and exhaust mind on the Milky Way.
idiomatic: I wear out spirit on the hill graves and exhaust mind on the Milky Way.

literal: When I weave ornament I expect brocade sashes; when I raise discourse it must be in fragrant words.
idiomatic: When I weave ornament I expect brocade sashes; when I raise discourse it must be in fragrant words.

literal: This is beauty in itself—I have no part in it.
idiomatic: That is beauty in itself—I have no part in it.

literal: I once tried to discuss it: the Kunlun peak piles jade—the lustrous piece is destroyed first;
idiomatic: I once tried to discuss it: the Kunlun peak piles jade—the lustrous piece is destroyed first;

literal: the jade mountain clusters cassia—the fragrant and flourishing branch is broken first.
idiomatic: the jade mountain clusters cassia—the fragrant flourishing branch is broken first.

literal: Therefore in the eastern capital there were ministers who hung up their caps; in the southern state there appeared gentlemen who cast away feeling.
idiomatic: Therefore in the eastern capital there were ministers who hung up their caps; in the southern state there appeared gentlemen who cast away feeling.

literal: Was this because they hated fine grain and brocade and loved coarse greens?
idiomatic: Was that because they hated fine grain and brocade and loved coarse greens?

literal: They wished only to preserve their seven feet and complete their hundred years.
idiomatic: They wished only to preserve their seven feet and complete their hundred years.

literal: Now younger brother, your office and rank are already advanced and your fame and splendor already far; the tusk is gone because the teeth perish, the fat is used because the lamp burns bright—you have already read Laozi's talk of the valley spirit and should embody Marquis Liu's rest in knowing when to stop.
idiomatic: Now younger brother, your office and rank are already advanced and your fame and splendor already far; the tusk is gone because the teeth perish, the fat is used because the lamp burns bright—you have already read Laozi's talk of the valley spirit and should embody Marquis Liu's rest in knowing when to stop.

literal: If you can turn about to pure elevation, unfasten your girdle and cast aside your hairpin, then on this mountain of mine a lodge can be prepared at once.
idiomatic: If you can turn about to pure elevation, unfasten your girdle and cast aside your hairpin, then on this mountain of mine a lodge can be prepared at once.

literal: To link arms and enter the woods, hang the towel on drooping branches, carry wine and climb the height, spread mat on level mountain, speak plain resolve and discuss old friendship, inquire into cinnabar methods and converse on dark books—that too would be joy; why must one be rich and honored?
idiomatic: To link arms and enter the woods, hang the towel on drooping branches, carry wine and climb the height, spread mat on level mountain, speak plain resolve and discuss old friendship, inquire into cinnabar methods and converse on dark books—that too would be joy; why must one be rich and honored?

literal: Farewell, Master Yang—the road divides and our aims part; tracing this intent back, it is remote as the Milky Way.
idiomatic: Farewell, Master Yang—the road divides and our aims part; tracing this intent back, it is remote as the Milky Way.

literal: It is over—writing cannot exhaust the meaning.
idiomatic: It is over—writing cannot exhaust the meaning.
